error_log.description: Path and minimum log level for NGINX error messages.

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes (e.g., 'auto', '1', or a fixed integer).

worker_cpu_affinity.description: CPU affinity masks for worker processes (one mask per worker). Leave empty to disable.

debug_mode.description: Enable debug-level logging and debug points (use only for troubleshooting).

worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed per worker process.

use_epoll.description: Use Linux epoll() event model (automatically set on Linux if available).

use_kqueue.description: Use BSD kqueue() event model (set only on BSD-based systems).

log_format_main.description: Custom access log format using NGINX variables. Uses default combined log format if unchanged.

access_log.description: Path to the main access log file.

sendfile.description: Enable sendfile() for efficient file transfer (improves static file performance).

tcp_nopush.description: Enable TCP_CORK/TCP_NOPUSH to minimize packet size.

tcp_nodelay.description: Disable Nagle’s algorithm for real-time latency-sensitive apps (e.g., WebSockets).

keepalive_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for keep-alive connections with clients.

keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests served over a single keep-alive connection.

client_max_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size of client request body (e.g., '1m', '100k'). Set '0' to disable.

enable_gzip.description: Enable gzip compression for text-based responses to reduce bandwidth.

gzip_comp_level.description: Gzip compression level (1–9, where 9 is slowest but best compression).

gzip_min_length.description: Minimum response size (in bytes) to apply gzip compression.

gzip_types.description: MIME types eligible for gzip compression (text types, JSON, XML, JS, CSS, etc.).

sites.description: List of additional site configs to include (e.g., virtual hosts in /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/).

name.description: Descriptive name of the site config (e.g., 'myapp').

include_path.description: Absolute path to the site config file (e.g., '/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/myapp.conf').

upstreams.description: List of upstream groups for reverse proxy load balancing.

servers.description: Backend servers in this upstream group.

backup.description: Mark server as backup (only used when primary fail).

max_fails.description: Number of failed attempts before marking server down.

fail_timeout.description: Time after which a failed server is retried (e.g., '30s').

proxy_cache_paths.description: Define proxy cache storage paths for upstream responses.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path for cached data.

max_size.description: Maximum disk size for cached data (e.g., '1g').

inactive.description: Time before uncached data is purged (e.g., '60m').

use_temp_path.description: Use temporary path during writes (false recommended for performance).
